title: REQ · package.json and lockfile pin Phaser to 3.90.x
summary: Dependency declaration and lockfile resolve to Phaser 3.90.x
description: Context: package.json has "phaser": "^4.2.1"; the lockfile resolves 4.2.1 (node_modules/phaser at about L3445, root deps at L15). Desired behavior: the range is ~3.90.0 and the lockfile resolves a 3.90.x release. Expected result: a fresh npm ci installs Phaser 3.90.x. Why: the redesign mandates Phaser 3.90.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, When dependencies.phaser is read, Then it is ~3.90.0
Given package-lock.json, When node_modules/phaser.version is read, Then it matches 3.90.x

in_scope: phaser entry in package.json and package-lock.json

technical_constraints: Lockfile must be produced by npm, not hand-edited
